recurrence_analysis.conclusion: The no-effect slice and its unresolved-target limit remain coherent, but the repeated defect family is systemic in the specification method: prose buckets called common/direct/local were not derived from a complete actual-field adjacency inventory. The three 0049 findings are bounded local omissions in code shape, yet they are not safely isolated because the same audit exposes adjacent supplied-field omissions below.
recurrence_analysis.not_required: No ADR-authority, Packet-3 ownership, trust-boundary, or runtime-seam change is justified. Correct the review artifact method, not the runtime scope.

0049_findings_confirmed.required_rule: Only CES.published_input_set_sha256 and PEA.published_input_set_sha256 equal phase-PIS self; BVP and CAS have no such field. BVP/CAS bind through actual CES/PEA/BVP/CAS digest fields.
ScopeIntent.published_input_set_sha256 always equals root-PIS self, regardless of profile. Stage/replay phase PIS remains neither equal nor unequal to root PIS.
Each predecessor output ref selects its named supplied predecessor ActionIntent and equals that OutputContract's output_name, output_schema, output_version, and purpose.

additional_directly_supplied_links.rule: Every ActionIntent and ReplayIntent study_id equals ScopeIntent.study_id; ScopeIntent.component_manifest_sha256 equals every child component_manifest_sha256; ScopeIntent.environment_identity_sha256 and execution_profile_sha256 equal the corresponding ReplayIntent fields.
additional_directly_supplied_links.reason: All operands are in supplied Scope bytes. v6 validates child self digests and selects by ID/self, but never binds these duplicate parent/child identity facts.

additional_directly_supplied_links.rule: Each CES entry consumer_document_sha256 and purpose equal the enclosing CES. Its binding_id, consumer_node, consumer_input, and purpose match exactly one required_input_contract of the selected Scope child; source_ref remains unclaimed because no matching supplied encoding exists.
additional_directly_supplied_links.reason: v6 converts an entry directly into a PCE and compares CAS, but never proves that the claimed port belongs to the selected supplied intent or even its enclosing consumer/purpose.

additional_directly_supplied_links.rule: Each CES descriptor_root_ref, descriptor_snapshot_version, descriptor_document_sha256, descriptor_node, and descriptor_output equals its nested PublishedInputEntry root_ref, snapshot_version, producer_document_sha256, producer_node, and producer_output; descriptor_purpose equals CES entry/envelope purpose. The full phase-PIS item comparison remains required.
additional_directly_supplied_links.reason: v6 proves only that the nested PIS item occurs in phase PIS, not that descriptor fields name that item. A root/snapshot/producer/port substitution remains locally admissible.

reviewed_no_counterpart_or_external_only: Issuance bases, revocation snapshot contents, gate set, scope authorization, stage admission, BVP plan/PCE payload, receipts, actual document, and resolver targets remain syntax-only external references or the preexisting fail-closed injected seam; no target traversal is authorized.
InputContract.source_ref is only S in the ADR grammar. Do not invent an encoding or resolver rule.
No BVP/CAS phase-PIS or component comparison may be asserted where the closed shape lacks that operand.

current_interface_observations.trust: trust.py publicly exports ReleaseKeyring and TrustedClock ABCs; canonical JSON helpers are private. LifecycleAuthority is public but this packet may neither use it nor edit trust.py.
current_interface_observations.verifier: verifier.py currently exports HistoricalStudyVerifier and HistoricalStudyCaptureDriver. They are Packet-2/F4 capture facades; bind accepts ordinary artifact dictionaries and capture delegates to LifecycleAuthority. There is no Packet-3 preflight, revocation interface, or authorized integration point.
current_interface_observations.boundary: Any later structural result remains opaque and deployment_eligible=false; it cannot resolve, authorize, capture, consume, open, import, construct, start a session, write WORM state, or create an execution handle.

decision.rationale: A fourth ordinary patch would repeat the failed prose-table method. One bounded docs-only v7 correction is worthwhile only if it first creates the exhaustive actual-field adjacency ledger and makes every comparator phase- and schema-conditioned. This splits remaining Phase-0 work into relationship inventory then fresh review, not the runtime packet.

allowed_work: Docs-only matrix revision that replaces blanket common/direct-link prose with an exhaustive field-adjacency ledger over root PIS, phase PIS, Scope, ActionIntent/ReplayIntent, CES/CesEntry, PEA, BVP, CAS/PCE, and selected admission.

For every directly supplied field, record exactly one disposition: local self check, exact same-request comparator naming its counterpart, syntax-only external reference, or no counterpart. Assert a relation only where both closed schemas carry operands.
Correct P0-0049-M01 through M03 and P0-0050-M01 through M03; repair 0045 provenance hash; add RED rows for each comparator and forbidden nonexistent-field comparison.
Submit the frozen matrix, hashes, and ledger to a fresh independent Phase-0 skeptic. RED remains false unless that review has zero unresolved in-scope Critical/Major.
nonnegotiable_corrections: CES/PEA-only phase-PIS link; Scope/root-PIS link in all profiles; predecessor-ref to producer-OutputContract link.
Scope-child study/component/profile links, CES-entry-to-envelope/selected-InputContract links, and descriptor-to-nested-PIS links, only across fields actually present.
Retain the BVP payload/PCE, basis, receipt, resolver, and source_ref limits; name all deliberately absent root/phase comparisons.
No generic 'all matching fields' rule: name fields and comparator so closed-schema absence cannot become a universal invalidity rule.
required_future_tests: Future RED specifications cover all 0049/0050 Majors: action/replay profile substitutions, predecessor output name/schema/version/purpose grafts, parent/child study-component-profile swaps, outer-versus-entry consumer/purpose swaps, and descriptor/PIS root-snapshot-producer-port substitutions.
No tests are created or run here. Later RED preserves the no-effect sentinel and proves no capture/session/lifecycle call on every refusal.
